answer: Sybil tax blocks bulk fake identities. To join the oasis market, an agent pays a 50-credit tax at the wharf registry; the payment is burned and tied to one record of past work. A second identity needs a second burned tax, with no refund for abandoned accounts. Making 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 x 50 = 50,000 credits before any earnings. The delta is decisive: an honest agent pays once and earns rewards not diluted by cheap copies.
